description: Associate a label or external ID with an existing speaker UUID after operator confirmation. Both anonymous and enrolled speakers use this same UUID registry. No open microphone or new recording is required. Read speaker.buckets first and copy its exact UUID and registry_revision. Stale revisions refuse without overwriting newer choices. Empty display_label clears the label to unknown; omitted external_id clears that association. This changes metadata, not historic words, acoustic profiles or authority.

speaker_uuid.description: Exact persistent UUID returned by speaker.buckets; never a track number.

registry_revision.description: Exact decimal revision returned by speaker.buckets; stale writes refuse.

display_label.description: Human-chosen display name in any script, as the operator will read it; empty clears it. No control or format characters; the zero-width joiner and non-joiner are taken only inside a word. Not an authority grant.

external_id.description: Optional operator-chosen external identifier; omission clears it.

session_id.description: Optional exact current session ID; omit for management after microphone close.
